---
title: "Claustrum Connectivity in Prematurity Residual Diagnostics and Robust Inference (BLS)"
author: "Jil Wendt"
format: html
editor: visual
editor_options: 
  chunk_output_type: console
---

Residual diagnostics and robust inference for all reported models in the adult cohort (BLS; Supplementary control and robustness analyses, section 3): group comparison (CP \~ group + age at scan + sex) and GLMs in preterm-born adults (early social environment, degree of prematurity, cognition at 8 years, adult cognition). Diagnostics per model: residual skewness and kurtosis, Shapiro-Wilk, Breusch-Pagan, Cook's distance; Q-Q and scale-location plots for the group comparison. All tests are repeated with HC3 standard errors and Freedman-Lane permutation tests (5,000 permutations), with FDR correction within the same families as in the main analyses.

- Input: `data/adults_harmonized.csv`
- Outputs (`outputs/tables`):
  - `Revision_FDR_families_BLS_<date>.csv`: tests per FDR family (results/fdr_families_BLS.csv)
  - `Revision_diagnostics_CP_BLS_<date>.csv`: distribution of CP per ROI (results/diagnostics_CP_distribution_BLS.csv)
  - `Revision_residdiag_groupcomp_BLS_<date>.csv`, `Revision_residdiag_GLMs_BLS_<date>.csv`: residual diagnostics (results/diagnostics_residuals_groupcomp_BLS.csv, diagnostics_residuals_GLMs_BLS.csv)
  - `Revision_robustness_BLS_<date>.csv`: parametric, HC3 and permutation P-values (results/robustness_HC3_permutation_BLS.csv)
- Figures (`outputs/figures`): Q-Q and scale-location plots, `Revision313_BLS_*.png`

## Specific setup

```{r}
options(contrasts = c("contr.treatment", "contr.poly"))

# covariates in every model
covars    <- c("age_at_scan", "sex")
covar_rhs <- paste(covars, collapse = " + ")

# early social environment (full model)
terms_A1 <- c("ses0y2_facMiddle", "ses0y2_facLower", "psi1", "betreu", "optws")

# degree of prematurity
prematurity_vars <- c("tz", "gew", "inti")

# cognition at 8 years
cog8y_vars <- c("sif8", "stsed8", "stsgd8")

# adult cognition
cog_all <- c("wie_gesiq", "ant_alerting", "ant_orienting", "ant_congruency")

# descriptive threshold for "near zero" CP (fewer than 1 in 1000 seeded streamlines reaching the target) for table
NEAR_ZERO <- 0.001

# number of permutations
NPERM <- 5000
```

## Load data

```{r}
dat <- read_delim(
  here("data", "adults_harmonized.csv"),
  delim = ";",
  trim_ws = TRUE,
  locale = locale(decimal_mark = ","),
  na = c(""," ","NA", "NaN", "n/a", ".", "-9999","999"),
  col_types = cols(
    Subject = col_character(),
    ID      = col_character()
  ),
  guess_max = 10000
) |> janitor::clean_names()

# --- recode and name important factors ---
dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(case_when(
      groupcode == 0 ~ "FT",
      groupcode == 1 ~ "PT",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ), levels = c("FT", "PT")),

    sex = factor(case_when(
      sex == 1 ~ "Male",
      sex == 2 ~ "Female",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ), levels = c("Female", "Male"))
  )
```

### Make data subsets

```{r}
cp_vars <- grep("^cp_", names(dat), value = TRUE)

num_vars <- c(cp_vars, "age_at_scan", "psi1", "betreu", "optws",
              prematurity_vars, cog8y_vars, cog_all)

final_dat_CP <- dat |>
  mutate(
    across(all_of(num_vars), as.numeric),
    ses0y2_fac = factor(ses0y2, levels = c(1, 2, 3),
                        labels = c("Upper", "Middle", "Lower"))
  )

dat_PT <- final_dat_CP |> filter(group == "PT")

dat_PT_cog <- dat_PT |>
  mutate(across(all_of(cp_vars), ~ as.numeric(scale(.x))))
```

### Checks

```{r}
stopifnot(length(cp_vars) == 22)
stopifnot(all(cp_vars %in% names(roi_labels)))
stopifnot(all(sig_roi_codes %in% cp_vars))

stopifnot(all(num_vars %in% names(final_dat_CP)))
stopifnot(all(sapply(final_dat_CP[num_vars], is.numeric)))
```

### Overview of reported models

```{r}
models_BLS <- bind_rows(
  # Group comparison: CP ~ group + age + sex (full cohort)
  tibble(
    analysis = "GC group comparison",
    family   = "GC: group",
    dv       = cp_vars,
    rhs      = paste("group +", covar_rhs),
    data     = "final_dat_CP",
    term     = "groupPT",
    roi      = cp_vars
  ),
  # Analysis 1: CP ~ SES(factor) + PSI + PIRI + optws + age + sex (PT only)
  crossing(dv = cp_vars, term = terms_A1) |>
    mutate(
      analysis = "A1 early social environment",
      family   = paste("A1:", term),
      rhs      = paste("ses0y2_fac + psi1 + betreu + optws +", covar_rhs),
      data     = "dat_PT",
      roi      = dv
    ),
  # Analysis 2: CP ~ prematurity variable + age + sex (PT only)
  crossing(dv = cp_vars, term = prematurity_vars) |>
    mutate(
      analysis = "A2  prematurity",
      family   = paste("A2:", term),
      rhs      = paste(term, "+", covar_rhs),
      data     = "dat_PT",
      roi      = dv
    ),
  # Analysis 3: CP ~ cognition at 8y + age + sex (PT only)
  crossing(dv = cp_vars, term = cog8y_vars) |>
    mutate(
      analysis = "A3 cognition 8y",
      family   = paste("A3:", term),
      rhs      = paste(term, "+", covar_rhs),
      data     = "dat_PT",
      roi      = dv
    ),
  # Analysis 4: adult cognition ~ CP (z) + age + sex (PT only)
  crossing(dv = cog_all, term = cp_vars) |>
    mutate(
      analysis = "A4 adult cognition",
      family   = paste("A4:", dv),
      rhs      = paste(term, "+", covar_rhs),
      data     = "dat_PT_cog",
      roi      = term
    )
) |>
  mutate(
    ROI   = recode(roi, !!!roi_labels),
    model = paste(dv, "~", rhs)
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(analysis, family, ROI, roi, dv, rhs, data, term, model)

# FDR families: number of tests per family
fdr_families_BLS <- models_BLS |> count(analysis, family, name = "n_tests")

readr::write_csv2(fdr_families_BLS,
                  file.path(tab_dir, paste0("Revision_FDR_families_BLS_", Sys.Date(), ".csv")))
```

# 2 Diagnostics

## Helper functions

### Skewness/Kurtosis

```{r}
skew    <- function(x) e1071::skewness(x, na.rm = TRUE, type = 2)
ex_kurt <- function(x) e1071::kurtosis(x, na.rm = TRUE, type = 2)
```

### Residual diagnostics

```{r}
resid_diag <- function(fml, data) {
  d <- model.frame(fml, data = data, na.action = na.omit)
  
  fit    <- lm(fml, data = d)
  r      <- residuals(fit)
  cooksd <- cooks.distance(fit)
  sw     <- stats::shapiro.test(r)
  
  tibble(
    n             = nobs(fit),
    df_resid      = df.residual(fit),
    skew_resid    = skew(r),
    kurt_resid    = ex_kurt(r),
    shapiro_W     = unname(sw$statistic),
    shapiro_p     = sw$p.value,
    bp_p          = lmtest::bptest(fit)$p.value,
    max_cooksd    = max(cooksd),
    n_cooksd_high = sum(cooksd > 4 / nobs(fit))
  )
}
```

## 2.1 Distribution of raw CP per ROI

```{r}
cp_dist_BLS <- map_dfr(cp_vars, function(v) {
  x <- final_dat_CP[[v]]
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  tibble(
    dv            = v,
    ROI           = recode(v, !!!roi_labels),
    n             = length(x),
    mean          = mean(x),
    sd            = sd(x),
    min           = min(x),
    max           = max(x),
    n_zero        = sum(x == 0),
    pct_zero      = 100 * mean(x == 0),
    pct_near_zero = 100 * mean(x < NEAR_ZERO),
    skew          = skew(x),
    kurtosis      = ex_kurt(x),
    floor_in_sd   = mean(x) / sd(x)
  )
}) |> arrange(floor_in_sd)

readr::write_csv2(cp_dist_BLS,
                  file.path(tab_dir, paste0("Revision_diagnostics_CP_BLS_", Sys.Date(), ".csv")))
```

## 2.2 Residual diagnostics on all reported models

```{r}
models_unique_BLS <- models_BLS |> distinct(analysis, ROI, dv, rhs, data, model)

diag_BLS <- pmap_dfr(models_unique_BLS, function(analysis, ROI, dv, rhs, data, model) {
  out <- resid_diag(as.formula(model), get(data))
  mutate(out, analysis = analysis, ROI = ROI, model = model, .before = 1)
}) |>
  mutate(
    flag = case_when(
      abs(skew_resid) > 1 | bp_p < 0.05 ~ "assumptions questionable",
      abs(skew_resid) > 0.5             ~ "mild departure",
      TRUE                              ~ "ok"
    )
  )

diag_group_BLS <- diag_BLS |>
  filter(analysis == "GC group comparison") |>
  arrange(desc(abs(skew_resid)))

readr::write_csv2(diag_group_BLS,
                  file.path(tab_dir, paste0("Revision_residdiag_groupcomp_BLS_", Sys.Date(), ".csv")))
readr::write_csv2(filter(diag_BLS, analysis != "GC group comparison"),
                  file.path(tab_dir, paste0("Revision_residdiag_GLMs_BLS_", Sys.Date(), ".csv")))
```

## 2.3 Figures

```{r}
diag_panel_png <- function(dvs, which_plot, file, data, rhs,
                           labels = roi_labels, ncol = 5, cex_main = 0.9) {
  nr <- ceiling(length(dvs) / ncol)
  png(file, width = 300 * ncol, height = 280 * nr, res = 110)
  op <- par(mfrow = c(nr, ncol), mar = c(4, 4, 3, 1))
  for (dv in dvs) {
    fml <- as.formula(paste(dv, "~", rhs))
    d   <- model.frame(fml, data = data, na.action = na.omit)
    fit <- lm(fml, data = d)
    plot(fit, which = which_plot,
         main = recode(dv, !!!labels),
         sub.caption = "", caption = "", cex.main = cex_main)
  }
  par(op)
  dev.off()
  message("Saved: ", file)
}

rhs_group <- paste("group +", covar_rhs)

# --- All 22 ROIs ---
diag_panel_png(cp_vars, which_plot = 2,
               file = file.path(fig_dir, "Revision313_BLS_QQ_all22.png"),
               data = final_dat_CP, rhs = rhs_group)

diag_panel_png(cp_vars, which_plot = 3,
               file = file.path(fig_dir, "Revision313_BLS_scaleloc_all22.png"),
               data = final_dat_CP, rhs = rhs_group)

# --- FDR-significant ROIs only ---
diag_panel_png(sig_roi_codes, which_plot = 2,
               file = file.path(fig_dir, "Revision313_BLS_QQ_sigROIs.png"),
               data = final_dat_CP, rhs = rhs_group, ncol = 4)

diag_panel_png(sig_roi_codes, which_plot = 3,
               file = file.path(fig_dir, "Revision313_BLS_scaleloc_sigROIs.png"),
               data = final_dat_CP, rhs = rhs_group, ncol = 4)
```

# 3 Robust/permutation-based inference

- p_param = p-value from original run, as reported

- p_hc3 = p-value from heteroscedasticity-consistent (HC3) standard errors - for unequal variance

- p_perm = p-value from freedman-lane permutation test - for skewed, non-normal residuals

- FDR applied within same families as in the main manuscript analysis and separately for each type of test

## Helper function

```{r}
robust_p <- function(fml, data, terms, nperm = NPERM) {
  d   <- model.frame(fml, data = data, na.action = na.omit)
  fit <- lm(fml, data = d)
  cf  <- summary(fit)$coefficients
  
  missing_terms <- setdiff(terms, rownames(cf))
  if (length(missing_terms)) {
    stop("Term(s) ", paste(missing_terms, collapse = ", "),
         " not found in model: ", paste(deparse(fml), collapse = ""))
  }
  
  # HC3 robust standard errors
  hc3 <- lmtest::coeftest(fit, vcov. = sandwich::vcovHC(fit, type = "HC3"))
  
  # Freedman-Lane permutation
  perm     <- permuco::lmperm(fml, data = d, np = nperm, method = "freedman_lane")
  perm_tab <- as.data.frame(perm$table)
  if (!"resampled Pr(>|t|)" %in% names(perm_tab)) {
    stop("Column 'resampled Pr(>|t|)' not found in lmperm() output; see check in 5.1")
  }
  if (!all(terms %in% rownames(perm_tab))) {
    stop("Term name(s) differ between lm() and lmperm() output; see check in 5.1")
  }
  
  tibble(
    term      = terms,
    n         = nobs(fit),
    df_resid  = df.residual(fit),
    estimate  = cf[terms, "Estimate"],
    std_error = cf[terms, "Std. Error"],
    t_value   = cf[terms, "t value"],
    p_param   = cf[terms, "Pr(>|t|)"],
    p_hc3     = hc3[terms, "Pr(>|t|)"],
    p_perm    = perm_tab[terms, "resampled Pr(>|t|)"]
  )
}
```

## Run all tests

```{r}
set.seed(42)

model_keys <- models_BLS |> dplyr::distinct(model, data)

rob_BLS <- purrr::map2_dfr(model_keys$model, model_keys$data, function(m, dat_name) {
  rows <- models_BLS |>
    dplyr::filter(model == m, data == dat_name) |>
    dplyr::select(analysis, family, ROI, dv, term)
  out <- robust_p(as.formula(m), get(dat_name), rows$term)
  dplyr::left_join(rows, out, by = "term")
})

stopifnot(nrow(rob_BLS) == nrow(models_BLS))

rob_BLS <- rob_BLS |>
  group_by(family) |>
  mutate(
    p_param_fdr = p.adjust(p_param, "fdr"),
    p_hc3_fdr   = p.adjust(p_hc3,   "fdr"),
    p_perm_fdr  = p.adjust(p_perm,  "fdr")
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    sig_param = p_param_fdr < 0.05,
    sig_hc3   = p_hc3_fdr   < 0.05,
    sig_perm  = p_perm_fdr  < 0.05,
    agree     = (sig_param == sig_hc3) & (sig_param == sig_perm)
  )
```

## Save results

```{r}
readr::write_csv2(rob_BLS,
                  file.path(tab_dir, paste0("Revision_robustness_BLS_", Sys.Date(), ".csv")))
```
